cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: A Kinder Version
cards.instruction: Protect someone from the full truth by offering a carefully edited explanation that feels kinder than complete honesty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Nina's keeping her birthday dinner small. You and I can get noodles.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Small? She invited the whole choir.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. She's choosing people she sees every week. It isn't a verdict on your friendship.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We rehearse together every Tuesday. Read me her message.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: She wants an uncomplicated evening. That's the kindest accurate sentence. Come have one with me.
